name: encounter_probe_fresh
description: Fills the one cell no experiment today has measured: an ORDINARY, never-edited save fighting a REPEATABLE chapter-1 encounter. The fresh save has only ever fought squad 198, the scripted tutorial drone that flees, which an engine may well exempt from scaling; the level-19 save fought a chapter-5 encounter. So 'the god-mode save carries something' and 'chapter-1 repeatable encounters add +60 for everyone' both fit every reading taken so far. Carries the same squad edits as enemy_count_probe (squad 14 cut to one Sentry Drone, squad 321 to two) purely so the deciding fight is short, and ships with a copy of the untouched fresh save rather than any god-mode descendant.
